items.markdown:
![Kata Beach: 10 Reasons to visit Kata Beach in Phuket](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07271347-1672-0139-0000-baf34ecb8344:4)
Kata Beach is `a popular, family-friendly resort area on Phuket's west coast` , featuring a 1.5-kilometer white sand bay, clear calm waters from November to April, and surf waves from May to October.[](https://www.phuket101.net/kata-beach/) [[1]](https://www.phuket101.net/kata-beach/)[[2]](https://www.thailandretreats.com/Location/Kata)[[3]](https://www.sunshine.co.uk/hotels/phuket_kata_beach-hotels-2261.html)

Key Facts and Activities

- **Location & Travel** : Situated on the southwest coast of Phuket, roughly a 60–75 minute drive (about 45–50 km) from Phuket International Airport.[](https://www.thailandretreats.com/Location/Kata) [[1]](https://www.thavornpalmbeach.com/tips-kata-beach-travel-guide)[[2]](https://www.trivago.co.uk/en-GB/odr/hotels-kata-beach-thailand?search=200-15954)
- **Best Time to Visit** : Dry season runs from November to April for calm swimming conditions; wet season runs from May to October, which is ideal for surfing.[](https://www.sunshine.co.uk/hotels/phuket_kata_beach-hotels-2261.html) [[1]](https://www.lastminute.com/holidays/th_thailand/kata-beach-d1501155857)[[2]](https://www.agoda.com/travel-guides/thailand/phuket/uncover-kata-beach-phuket-your-ultimate-fun-itinerary/)[[3]](https://novotel.accor.com/a/en/great-escape-magazine/travel/kata-beach-thailand.html)
- **Beach Highlights** : Features soft sand, shade trees, sun lounger rentals, and a small offshore island (Koh Pu) at the north end good for snorkeling.[](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/thailand/phuket-kata-beach/holidays-phuket-kata-beach.html) [[1]](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/thailand/phuket-kata-beach/holidays-phuket-kata-beach.html)[[2]](https://uk.hotels.com/go/thailand/kata-beach)
- **Dining & Nightlife** : Offers beachside food stalls, local street food just off the main road, and evening visits to the local night markets.[](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/thailand/phuket-kata-beach/holidays-phuket-kata-beach.html) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FUdvWwzUK68&t=36)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/bbAriely.travel/videos/kata-beach-is-beautiful-but-the-second-you-hit-the-main-strip-the-prices-switch-/1278299357369363/)

items.title: Is it better to stay in Kata or Patong?

expanded_element.title: Kata Beach vs Patong Beach: Which Phuket Area Is Better?
expanded_element.description: Neither beach is universally better; the right choice depends on your travel preferences. Kata Beach is generally recommended for visitors seeking relaxation, beautiful scenery, and a family-friendly environment, while Patong Beach is better suited to travelers who prioritize nightlife, shopping, and entertainment.

expanded_element.title: Kata Beach Nightlife: Bars, Clubs & Night Markets - Andaman Cannacia
expanded_element.description: Kata Beach nightlife offers a well-balanced mix of beach bars, live music venues, night markets, and stylish beach clubs all without the overwhelming intensity found in busier party hubs. The vibe here is vibrant but approachable.

expanded_element.title: Kata Beach: Where To Stay, What To Do - Phuket 101
expanded_element.description: While it can be busy in high season, Kata is less crowded than Patong and still offers a vast choice of hotels, from cheap guesthouses to 5-star hotels, private pool villas and just a couple of lucky beach access hotels. This beach has enough beach chairs with umbrellas and beach massages for a great, relaxing holiday.
